mix.text: Hello friends, it's tactical time. Let's count big all the way to a thousand. Ready? Let's go!
Ten little ones make one ten, bundle them up and count again, ten tens together, what do you see?
One hundred, one, zero, zero, look at three four five, let's take it apart, three hundreds first, that's where we start,
Then four tens and five ones too
Put each digit in its space
All the way to one thousand
It means no tens, not one more
8 ones, hooray, 708, that's how we say
Which is bigger? Which is more?
Look at the hundreds, first for sure
Both are 400s, so look at the tens
Put each digit in its space
All the way to 1,000 every time
Three hundreds, three hundreds in three, four, five
Seven zero eight, how many tens?
Which is bigger? Three zero nine or three nine zero?
Hundreds, tens, and ones, every number has a place.
Hundreds, tens, and ones, put each digit in its space.
Count by hundreds, up we climb, all the way to 1,000 every time.
